description: Open jobs of a company whose careers site runs on Jobvite (jobs.jobvite.com/<company>): every open position with department, title, location (or number of locations) and link, plus counts per department as a hiring signal; with a job id, that posting's details (date posted, employment type, department, locations, salary range when published, description text). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

company.description: Jobvite company slug, e.g. egnyte (from jobs.jobvite.com/<slug>/jobs)

job.description: Optional job id from a listing (e.g. ozPYAfwG) for the full posting

q.description: Optional keyword filter on title, department or location

name: b2b_jobvite_jobs
title: B2b Jobvite Jobs
